script.text: As the tournament continued, Joey was challenged by Weevil Underwood. But what Joey didn't know was that Weevil was using his underhanded tricks again.
Weevil slipped a card into Joey's deck that would make sure that none of Joey's strategies would work.
We’ll settle dis fair and square with a duel. A’right, let’s do dis!
That's fine with me, but we'll duel for two Locator Cards!
That’s if you even have two!
Yugi squashed this creepy little bug the first time dey squared off in Duelist Kingdom. Now I guess it’s my turn to do the same.
